document_metadata.summary: Ted confronts Paul with suspicion over Raymond's death; after a tense exchange and a power outage, Ted leaves as Paul remains alone in the dark, signing documents.

entities.name: Ted enters the shop with bruises and keeps his parka on

entities.description: Avis rises from her seat to welcome Ted upon his arrival in the shop.

entities.name: Paul greets Ted and notices his bruises
entities.description: Paul approaches Ted, extends his hand, and reacts with visible shock upon seeing the bruises on Ted's face, though he appears to understand their origin.

entities.name: Ted hands over an envelope and documents to Paul
entities.description: Ted sits at Paul's desk, retrieves an envelope and several forms from his briefcase, and slides them across the desk for Paul to sign.

entities.name: Ted mentions being mugged and the police investigation
entities.description: Ted tells Paul that he was mugged and that the police consider it a random act of violence, though he implies doubt about that explanation.

entities.name: Paul searches for a pen in his desk drawer
entities.description: While reviewing the documents, Paul opens his desk drawer to retrieve a pen, inadvertently revealing the Sea Shell inside.

entities.name: Ted notices the Sea Shell in Paul's drawer
entities.description: As Paul opens his desk drawer, Ted sees the Sea Shell and comments on it, prompting Paul to pick it up and explain its significance.

entities.name: Paul explains the origin and sentimental value of the Sea Shell
entities.description: Paul tells Ted that the shell was a gift from Raymond, bought in Florida, and that it is one of the few remaining mementos of him.

entities.name: Ted sarcastically references Paul's inheritance and marital status
entities.description: Ted remarks on Paul receiving a million dollars and being a newly single man, implying insincerity about Paul's claim of loving his wife.

entities.name: Paul asserts his love for his wife
entities.description: Paul firmly states that he loves his wife very much, delivering the declaration with sincerity that confuses Ted.

entities.name: Ted attempts to have an honest conversation with Paul
entities.description: Ted asks Paul if they can speak candidly for a moment, seeking clarity about a sensitive matter, but is interrupted before finishing his question.

entities.description: A delivery driver enters the office carrying a large box, cutting off Ted's attempt to ask Paul a critical question.
